questions.q: What has to exist before a chart widget can be added to a dashboard?
options: A report with the grouping and values the chart needs
A separate dashboard filter
An approved page layout
A custom report type with no related objects
questions.explain: A chart widget visualizes a source report's existing grouping and values. It performs no new calculation, so the underlying report has to already be built correctly.

questions.q: In the Add Widget dialog, what does the live preview show?
options: A generic placeholder until the dashboard is saved
The actual chart, built from the real source report, before you commit
Only the widget's title and eyebrow text
A list of other dashboards using the same report
questions.explain: The preview renders the real chart from the selected report and settings in real time, so you see exactly what will be added before confirming.

questions.q: Which chart type best fits showing each sales stage's share of total pipeline, as parts of a whole?
options: Line chart
Donut or pie chart
Table
Text widget
questions.explain: Donut and pie charts are built for parts-of-a-whole comparisons. A line chart is suited to trends over time, not a single snapshot's proportions.

questions.q: What does "Use chart settings from report" do when adding a widget?
options: It deletes the source report once the widget is added
It lets the widget inherit the chart configuration already set on the source report
It forces the widget to use a Table display regardless of selection
It hides the widget from the dashboard until manually enabled
questions.explain: This option reuses the report's own chart configuration for the widget, keeping the report and its dashboard component visually consistent without reconfiguring from scratch.

questions.q: Why would a funnel chart be a good fit for a pipeline-by-stage dashboard component?
options: Funnels are required by Salesforce for all Opportunity reports
Funnels show a sequence with expected drop-off between stages, which matches how a pipeline narrows
Funnels are the only chart type that supports live previews
Funnels automatically calculate win rate without a source report
questions.explain: A funnel visually represents a sequence that's expected to narrow at each stage — exactly the shape of a sales pipeline moving from early to late stages.
